issues.description: Script uses GM_xmlhttpRequest to communicate with api.torn.com and twse.dev. User's Torn API key is collected via prompt and stored in localStorage, and may be sent to these endpoints for API calls.
issues.recommendation: Ensure only necessary data is sent, and endpoints are trusted. Warn users about API key usage and storage.

issues.description: Script stores and retrieves the Torn API key and other settings in localStorage, which is accessible to any script running on the same domain/context.
issues.recommendation: Minimize sensitive data storage in localStorage. Consider using more secure storage if possible.

issues.description: @grant unsafeWindow is requested, but not used in the provided code. This is a high-privilege grant and can be abused if used carelessly.
issues.recommendation: Remove unused high-privilege grants to reduce attack surface.

issues.description: @require is not used, but @grant GM_xmlhttpRequest is present. Ensure only necessary permissions are requested.
Script loads and injects CSS via <style> tags, but does not use innerHTML/outerHTML with untrusted input. No DOM XSS found.
issues.recommendation: Continue to avoid inserting untrusted content into the DOM.

details: Torn API key is collected and stored in localStorage via prompt
Other user preferences stored in localStorage

summary: The script collects and stores the user's Torn API key in localStorage, and transmits it to api.torn.com and twse.dev via GM_xmlhttpRequest. This is a critical privacy and data exfiltration risk. The script also requests high-privilege grants (unsafeWindow) that are not used, increasing the attack surface. No code obfuscation or DOM XSS was detected. Supply chain risk is low as no @require is used. The script should warn users about API key handling, minimize permissions, and avoid storing sensitive data in localStorage.
